title: Velocity from Position
prompt:
A ball thrown upward has height s(t) = 8*t - 5*t^2 (metres, g = 10 m/s²).

Find its velocity v(t) = ds/dt.
hint: differentiate term by term: d/dt[a*t] = a, d/dt[t^2] = 2*t
recap: Velocity is the time-derivative of position: v(t) = ds/dt. Differentiate term by term — d/dt[a·t] = a and d/dt[t²] = 2t — so s = u·t − 5t² gives v = u − 10t.
